name: evidence-exchange
description: Post-inspection evidence exchange and deficiency determination system for state adult family home licensing programs

scripts.db:reset: rm -f prisma/dev.db && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.vercel-build: node scripts/make-pg-schema.mjs && prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && next build
scripts.pg:ddl: node scripts/make-pg-schema.mjs && prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.postgres.prisma --script
